PtyCrPrflFinclAcctActvty.name: PtyCrPrflFinclAcctActvty
PtyCrPrflFinclAcctActvty.description: Represents information about the payments made by a borrower reported by a credit bureau. Reveals a borrower's payment behavior on past debts, indicating timely, delayed, or skipped payments.

IsPaymentMadeOnTime.description: Indicates whether the payment was made on time (true) or not (false).

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

PartyCreditPrflFinclAcctId.description: The financial account associated with the payment activity.
